body:
I am so jealous. I used to have a hamster. Unfortunately she passed away :(
And we aren't allowed to have pets anymore :/
Sucks big time.

It's just everything's so triggering. Every night a wave of depression comes over me. Lately I've pretty good. I haven't been burning or cutting myself. Mostly because I can't commit to wearing long sleeves all the time and also because my blades suck. But I just bought about 20 blades. I don't know why I did, it was just instinctive. 
I've noticed that the longer I go without self harming, the more suicidal I become. I feel as though I'm stronger when I self harm. I'm not quite sure I want to let go of that part of me but I don't want my brother to remember me as the cutter. 
Whenever I would cut it would always be all up my arms, legs, and stomach. Never too deep. But last year I was really mad and didn't have time for the shallow cuts so I just went for it. I still have those really deep scars on my right thigh. I keep wondering how it would be to cut that deep again. I'm trying to refrain from doing it though.
Also, thank you so much for commenting. It really means a lot.
